turnaround_reason: High-quality subscription research compounder whose stock was nearly halved on a sharp growth slowdown (contract value decel, tariff/budget delays) and fears that GenAI erodes the value of paid research. Business quality is intact; the multiple has reset.
bullish_points: Best business in the batch: ~70% gross margin, 22% op margin, 12% net margin, ~$1.05B FCF
Fwd P/E ~10.4 — cheap vs its own history for a sticky subscription model
Sticky, high-retention research subscriptions; disciplined buybacks
Fair-value narratives (~$283) sit well above the reset price
bearish_points: Growth slowing hard: ~6.7% (2025) to ~3.3% (2026) guide, below IT-spend growth
GenAI overhang — genuine question whether AI commoditizes syndicated research
Tariff/budget-driven decision delays hitting new-business contract value
UBS downgrade; sentiment negative near term
catalyst: Contract-value growth re-acceleration and evidence AI is additive (not substitutive) to research demand
catalyst_timing: FY2026 quarterly prints; watch CV growth inflection
suggested_trade: Spot accumulation on weakness; Jan 2027 calls for leverage to a CV re-accel
key_risk: GenAI structurally impairs research renewals, making the slowdown secular rather than cyclical
would_skip_if: Skip if contract-value growth decelerates further or net retention breaks below trend
